bbox-clip: Clip a Feature to a bounding box using lineclip. Polygons become polygon intersections, LineStrings become clipped segments, Points keep those inside.
boolean-overlap: Compare two geometries of the same dimension. Returns true when their intersection is a geometry of that dimension but different from both inputs.
line-slice-along: Take a line, a start distance and a stop distance along it, and return the subsection of the line between those two points on the original path.
sector: Create a circular sector of a given radius centered at a Point, between two bearings measured clockwise from North (0 is due North of the center).
json-execute-javascript: Execute a JavaScript script with a JSON object bound as the global variable 'json'. Returns the value of the last expression evaluated in the script.
cloudflare-model: Run any model from the Cloudflare Workers AI catalog. Pick one and the node rebuilds its inputs and outputs from the model's published schema.
cloudflare-gateway-model: Run any third-party model from Cloudflare's unified AI catalog (xAI, OpenAI, Google) via the AI Gateway. Pick one and the node adapts its inputs and outputs.
cloudflare-browser-json: Extract structured JSON from a JavaScript-rendered page. Give it a URL plus a prompt or a JSON schema, and get typed data back instead of raw HTML.
cloudflare-browser-screenshot: Capture a screenshot of any URL or raw HTML string. Set the viewport, cookies and authentication, then pass the resulting image straight to the next node.
cloudflare-browser-markdown: Convert a rendered web page into clean Markdown, ready for an LLM prompt or a RAG index. Handles JavaScript-heavy pages that a plain HTTP fetch would miss.
photon-crop: Crop an image to an exact rectangle given x, y, width and height. Runs on Photon compiled to WebAssembly, so no external image service is involved.
photon-resize: Resize an image to an exact width and height, choosing the sampling filter that fits the quality you need. Runs on Photon compiled to WebAssembly.
